1 2.
The case of the prosecution is that as per the defacto complainant, the 1st petitioner has created the fake sale deed and executed in favour of his wife/second petitioner.
Further, based on the complaint given by the defacto complainant, the case was registered by the 1st respondent in Crime No.19 of 2016 for the offence punishable under Sections 420, 465 & 468 of IPC.
Subsequently, the 1st respondent police has filed a final report before the trial Court in C.C.No.25 of 2022.
Challenging the said final report, the petitioners have approached this Court to quash the proceedings.

3. The learned counsel for the petitioners submitted that the 1st https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis petitioner and the defacto complainant are the brother and sisters, they are the legal heir of one Kista Reddy had obtained two separate properties item No.1 sale deed dated 03.05.2006 and item No.2 partition deed dated 17.12.2008.

He further submitted that the item No.1 was mortgaged in favour of the Tamil Nadu Co-operative Bank vide Doc.No.1525 of 1998 and Doc.No.1526 of 1998 which the same is an agricultural cum joint family property and all other legal heir including the 1st petitioner extended their support for one of the legal heir viz., Jothi Baskar who signed the registered Loan Document and no one has redeemed the said property.

He further submitted that the second respondent requested the 1st petitioner to sell the item No.1 property for market price,
thereafter, the the defacto complainant has obtained signature from the 1st petitioner in some document and at the time of entering the said deed in favour of her son Rajasekar.

Further, the defacto complainant requested the 1st petitioner to receive a quantum of money as advance for signing in the sale agreement dated 03.05.2006 and also she undertook to pay the remaining amount within the short time.
Thereafter, she has not paid the amount.

Further, the 1st petitioner ,
getting aged and https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis facing lot of medical problems had out of love and affection had settled his share of the proprety in favour of his wife/second petitioner.

Further,
the 1st petitioner has filed a suit in O.S.No.61 of 2016 to declare the alleged sale deed vide Doc.No.4189 dated 03.05.2006 as null and void.
In the mean time, the defacto complainant has given a false complaint before the 1st respondent police.
Hence, he prayed to allow this petition.

4. Heard learned Governement Advocate (Crl.Side) appearing for the 1st responden police.
5.
The learned counsel for the second respondent submitted that the petitioners have intentionally grabbed the property belongs to the second respondent.

He further submitted that the second respondent has filed a suit in O.S.No.168 of 2016 to cancel the settlement deed in favour of the second petitioner and the same decreed in favour ot the second respondent.
Hence, he prays for dismissal of this petition.

6. On a perusl of the records, it reveals that the second respondent https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis has filed a suit in O.S.No.168 of 2016 to cancel the settlement deed infavour of the second petitioner and the same was decreed in favour of the second respondent, in the said suit.
As on date, the said decree is inforce.
Further, the 1st petitioner and the second respondent are brother and sister, there was a civil dispute between the petitioners and the defacto complainant.

Therefore, this Court is of the view that the dispute is civil in nature, thus Civil dispute has been given criminal colour and also considering the age of the petitioners aged about 70 and 68 years and there is no primafacie materials that petitioners acted with dishonest intention.

Hence, this Court is inclined to quash the proceedings in C.C.No.25 of 2022 on the file of the Special Judicial Magistrate Court, for Land K.Rangan vs The State Represented By on 16 February, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/159558902/
2
Grabbing case, Thiruvallur.
7. In the result, this Criminal Original Petition is allowed.
Consequently, connected miscellaneous petitions are closed.
No costs.
